title: Compute brief — 29 September 2026
description: Silicon Tape all confirms: Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DO B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97. AWS Capacity Blocks posts Oct 7 forward rate card (current table still confirms). Crusoe names Google Armstrong County TX developer role (Signal). Brookwood still ~1 Oct. No new Wire ids.
og_kicker: Tape all confirms; AWS CB Oct 7 card posted
lede: Tuesday's public rental tape is flat, and hyperscaler reservation pricing just posted a forward markup. Same-venue Silicon Tape re-read this morning: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda / CoreWeave / Crusoe / DigitalOcean / GCP TPU / AWS Capacity Blocks. Lambda on-demand anchors hold at H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X spot $2.46 / MI355X spot $2.97 all confirm versus Monday. AWS's Capacity Blocks page now banners a rate-card update effective 7 Oct 2026 (P5 to $5.970 / accelerator, P6-B200 to $14.208, P6-B300 to $16.146, with GovCloud adders) while the live table still prints current rates (P5 Virginia $5.191 CONFIRM) — so the tape does not tick until the table moves. Separately, Crusoe's 28 Sep newsroom names the company as developer of Google's Armstrong County, Texas campus already under construction since June 2025 (Goodnight wind co-location) — Signal only, not a new Wire id. Applied Digital's Brookwood / Delta Forge 2 campus remains on a ~1 Oct construction start with tenant still unnamed; PUCT 58481 still Interchange 218/219 (effective 10.08.2026); TCEQ Abbott update still due 19 Oct; Fermi×TensorWave Matador still due 31 Oct.
